footnote_text: This security represents restricted stock units granted under the Issuer's 2026 Equity Incentive Plan as an initial one-time grant to the Reporting Person in connection with his appointment to the Issuer's Board of Directors. Each restricted stock unit represents a contingent right to receive one share of common stock of the Issuer. || This restricted stock unit grant vests in equal annual installments over a period of three years beginning on September 3, 2026, in each case subject to the Reporting Person's continued service with the Issuer through the applicable vesting date.
